current_point.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法，用于在大规模图数据中高效划分子图并分配给分布式计算节点，支持后续图神经网络训练。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed an edge-segmentation-based graph streaming partitioning algorithm for efficiently partitioning large-scale graphs into subgraphs and assigning them to distributed computing nodes, supporting subsequent graph neural network training.
source_locations: 论文摘要：DSGNN 模型中提到的图流划分算法
正文：领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法进行划分
technical_features: 以边分割为基础进行图流划分
从流式数据中动态划分原图
将划分后的子图分配给各工作节点
适用于大规模图数据的分布式处理
technical_features_en: Partition graph stream based on edge segmentation
Dynamically partition the original graph from streaming data
Assign partitioned subgraphs to worker nodes
Suitable for distributed processing of large-scale graph data
